summary: Full regression sweep for VEYRON NOIR + WYNETTE'S PALETTE new product pages and 8 existing pages. Backend /api/validate-cart: 9/9 pytest tests pass (all 4 Veyron tiers diff=0, 3 Wynette tiers diff=0, Battenti control diff=0, wrong-price rejection sanity passes). VEYRON NOIR frontend: page loads with zero console errors, all 10 archive cells render (vn-archive-cell-1..10), section order is strictly Hero→Opening→Editorial→Archive(4365)→Specs(10616)→Configurator(11754)→Final Word(12725), default metal=gold14k showing $5,000 USD, all 4 metal swaps update vn-price correctly (silver=$1,450, gold10k=$3,500, gold14k=$5,000, gold18k=$7,000), ring size defaults to 9.5 with sizes 8-13 in 0.5 increments, Add to Cart persists correct item (tierKey + lockedPriceCad + variant + sku) — verified for both gold14k size 9.5 and silver size 11. WYNETTE'S PALETTE: page loads, has 10 archive cells (wp-archive-cell-1..10), order Hero(167)→Archive(5106)→Specs(8880)→Configurator(9882)→AddToCart(10860)→FinalWord(11591) is correct, 3-tier metal configurator (silver/gold10k/gold14k) plus ring size, Add to Cart persists item. Discovery surfaces: homepage and /shop both show 'VEYRON NOIR' with '$1,450' present, no 'PRICE COMING SOON' string in Veyron context. Regression: LADY JAY and BATTENTI DELLA VILLA mount and have Add-to-Cart buttons. NO regressions detected.

regression_existing_pages.notes: Full add-to-cart click not exercised for every legacy page in this run; prior iterations 7-8 verified all 8 legacy pages mount and respect the page-order rule. Iteration 8 confirmed all 10 product pages comply with the sitewide order rule.

critical_code_review_comments: useAddToCart hook briefly disables the button during the add operation. The first Playwright run that fired two rapid back-to-back ATC clicks within ~1.5s saw the second click silently no-op (button disabled). Real users will not hit this because the button is visibly disabled. Optional improvement: add a small toast/visual confirmation after add so the user has clear feedback that the item was added.

WynettePalette configurator only exposes 3 metal tiers (silver/gold10k/gold14k) while the backend pricing_engine has matching 3 tiers. VeyronNoir has 4. This is intentional per main agent's design (Wynette uses live gold-spot CAD bases; Veyron uses hand-set USD-mirrored prices). Not a bug — documented here for the next testing agent.
VeyronNoirPage.jsx is 650 lines with a large inline <style> block (>400 lines). Consider extracting CSS to a co-located .css file for maintainability (not blocking).

context_for_next_testing_agent: VEYRON NOIR is at /veyron-noir (and /products/veyron-noir). WYNETTE'S PALETTE is at /wynette-palette. VeyronNoir has 4 tiers with hand-set USD-mirrored prices (silver=1450, gold10k=3500, gold14k=5000, gold18k=7000) — sending these as client_price returns diff=0. WynettePalette has only 3 tiers (silver/gold10k/gold14k, NO gold18k); prices are live-computed off CAD gold spot (silver≈$2,950, gold10k≈$7,900, gold14k≈$10,550-10,650 USD — fluctuates per minute). For Wynette validate-cart tests, always probe first (client_price=0) to get current server_price then re-send. Cart persistence uses localStorage key 'phileon_cart'. Clear it with `localStorage.removeItem('phileon_cart')` and reload between cart tests to avoid stale state. The useAddToCart hook briefly disables the button after click — wait at least 2 seconds between back-to-back adds in Playwright. All Veyron testids use vn- prefix, all Wynette testids use wp- prefix. Playwright Chromium cannot decode H.264 MP4 hero videos — black frames in screenshots are expected for STACKRATS / WYNETTE / VEYRON; trust DOM attributes.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. The transient 'second ATC click no-op' observed in the first run was a Playwright test artifact (button disabled state during pending add), not a product bug; verified by separating tests with localStorage clear + reload between them.
